transcript: Speaker A (Conductor): यह बस आगे नहीं जाएगी इसमें वजन बहुत ज्यादा है। कुछ लोगों को उतरना होगा। [This bus won't go further, there is too much weight. Some people will have to get down.] Speaker B (Man): इसे उतार दो ना, इसका वजन बहुत ज्यादा है। [Make her get down, her weight is too much.] Speaker C (Woman): Why should I stand up? I have paid the full ticket price. I am a complete individual and do not require any health certificate from you. Speaker B (Man): अगर हम लड़ाई नहीं करते तो हमें बस से नहीं उतारते। वैसे आपने इतनी फर्राटेदार अंग्रेजी कहां से सीखी? [If we hadn't fought, they wouldn't have kicked us off the bus. By the way, where did you learn such fluent English?] Speaker C (Woman): English Seekho ऐप से। पहले मुझे भी अंग्रेजी नहीं आती थी। फिर मैंने खुद को एक चैलेंज दिया और दो महीने तक रोज 15 मिनट English Seekho ऐप से प्रैक्टिस की। और आज आप मेरी अंग्रेजी से प्रभावित हो रहे हैं। [From English Seekho app. Earlier I also didn't know English. Then I gave myself a challenge and practiced for 15 minutes daily for two months on the English Seekho app. And today you are impressed by my English.] Speaker D (Voiceover): तो इंस्टॉल बटन पर क्लिक करो और English Seekho ऐप डाउनलोड करो। [So click on the install button and download the English Seekho app.]
on_screen_text: English Seekho, INSTALL NOW. [Disclaimer text explaining that the app is not affiliated with any government authority and results may vary based on individual effort.]
summary: A woman facing public fat-shaming on a bus confidently defends herself in fluent English, silencing her detractors. She later credits her speaking skills to practicing 15 minutes daily on the English Seekho app. The ad ends with a call to action to install the app.
